java-cycle.description: Java: packages order and billing use each other (cycle); shared is used by both; a test file closes another cycle and is left out.

java-layered.description: Java: web uses service uses domain; no cycle, dependencies point toward stability.

ts-cycle.description: TypeScript: cart and pricing folders import each other; cartTotals does not take part.

ts-unstable.description: TypeScript: core is used by a, b and c (instability 0.25) and uses experimental (0.5), which is less stable.

ts-stable.description: TypeScript: core is used by a, b and c and uses only model, which nothing else changes (stable).

java-hub.description: Java: hub is used by four packages and uses four others, in a system of nine packages.

java-facade.description: Java: api is used by six packages but uses only one: widely used, not a hub.

sap-commerce-extension.description: SAP Commerce extension: service and dao packages in src use each other (cycle); the generated model in gensrc also closes a cycle with service and is left out.

salesforce-lwc-cycle.description: Salesforce LWC: cartStore and pricingUtils import each other through c/ modules; cartPanel uses cartStore only.

salesforce-lwc-acyclic.description: Salesforce LWC: cartPanel uses cartStore, which uses pricingUtils; no cycle.
